note: Trend Following + Momentum for Crypto. Combines dual MA trend filter with momentum filter. Reproduces classic trend following (MA crossover) + cross-sectional momentum (Jegadeesh/Titman 1993) from public sources. Daily and 4H timeframes supported.

signal.entryExpression: fast_ma[t] > slow_ma[t] AND close[t] > slow_ma[t] AND momentum[t] > 0
signal.exitExpression: fast_ma[t] < slow_ma[t] (trend break) OR ATR stop hit
signal.note: Edge-triggered entry on condition transition from False to True

risk.timeExitRule: none (hold until trend break or stop)

sources: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) - Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers (momentum)
Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen (2012) - Time Series Momentum
freqtrade/freqtrade-strategies - EMA Crossover, MACD+RSI trend strategies (public)
